title: Guidelines for Fast-Track Courts for POCSO Cases
content:
Supreme Court directed establishment of Fast-Track Special Courts (FTSCs) for POCSO (Protection of Children from Sexual Offences) cases.
Key directives:
1. Trial to be completed within 1 year of cognizance.
2. Victim's identity must be protected (Section 23 POCSO Act).
3. Child Welfare Committee (CWC) must be involved.
4. Medical examination within 24 hours of complaint.
5. Statement of child to be recorded by Magistrate within 30 days.
PRACTICAL: In POCSO cases, cite these guidelines to push for fast-tracking.
